stem: Why do current caries-risk assessment models combine several types of information instead of relying on a single measure?

options.text: Caries is determined mainly by oral microflora, and the other data only confirm that result.
Social, cultural, and behavioral factors are left out so the model stays objective.
Fluoride exposure is not considered a component of caries risk.
Caries has multiple etiologic factors, including diet, fluoride exposure, host susceptibility, and microflora, that interact with social, cultural, and behavioral influences.
